sources.title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction ...
sources.snippet: A major challenge for modern AI is to learn to understand the world and learn to act largely by observation. This paper explores a self-supervised approach that combines internet-scale video data with a small amount of interaction data (robot trajectories), to develop models capable of understanding, predicting, and planning in the physical world.
